content.Text: Capes are best when they're lightweight. I recommend the aerodynamic flutter fabric.
Do you think capes should be mandatory?
Absolutely! A hero without a cape is just a person in a costume.
What about the mask situation?
Masks are essential for identity. No one should know your real name!
I prefer my mask with a little extra sparkle.
Sparkle is key. The best heroes shimmer when they land.
What about sidekick capes?
Sidekick capes should be slightly shorter. It's a hierarchy thing.
I hear you on that one.
Agreed! Now if you'll excuse me, I have a cape to iron.
See you at the tower!
Later! Remember to stretch your cape before flying.
Will do. Thanks, mentor!
Anytime, sidekick. Now go save the town!
